EC1: Patient has previously received or is receiving an organ transplant [NOT] other than a liver.
EC3: Recipient [OR] or donor [AND] is known to be seropositive for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)
EC4: Patient has received a liver transplant from a [NOT] non-heart beating donor
EC5: Patient who is HCV negative has received an HCV [AND] positive (HCV RNA [OR] by PCR or HCV antibody) donor liver
EC6: Patient who is HbsAg negative has received an HbsAg positive (HBV DNA [AND] by PCR [OR] or HBV antibody) donor liver
EC7: Patient has received a liver transplant from a decrease donor > 70 years of age
EC8: Patient has a current malignancy [OR] or a history of malignancy (within the past 5 years), [NOT] except hepatocellular carcinoma [AND] within UCSF Criteria and basal [OR] or non-metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of skin that has been treated successfully.
EC9: Patient is hemodynamically unstable [AND] on POD 15
